registerPBS: Register a Proxmox Backup Server to manage backups.
pbsUnreachableDesc: Could not connect to the PBS server. Check credentials and connectivity.
failedLoadPBS: Failed to load PBS data. Check server connectivity.
gcDescription: This will start garbage collection on datastore {{store}}. This removes unreferenced chunks and reclaims disk space.

gcDialog.title: Run garbage collection
gcDialog.description: This will start garbage collection on datastore {{store}}. This removes unreferenced chunks and reclaims disk space.

pruneDialog.title: Prune {{store}}
pruneDialog.description: Set how many snapshots to keep, then preview which ones would be removed.

deleteSnapshotConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{snapshot}} from {{datastore}}? This action cannot be undone.

deleteSnapshotDialog.title: Delete snapshot
deleteSnapshotDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete {{type}}/{{id}} from {{datastore}}? This action cannot be undone.

changeOwnerDialog.title: Change owner of {{group}}
changeOwnerDialog.description_one: All {{count}} snapshot of {{group}} on {{datastore}}, now owned by <owner>{{owner}}</owner>.
changeOwnerDialog.description_other: All {{count}} snapshots of {{group}} on {{datastore}}, now owned by <owner>{{owner}}</owner>.
changeOwnerDialog.explanation: PBS adds backups to a group only for its owner, or for the owner's user when the owner is an API token. A storage that signs in as anyone else fails with “backup owner check failed”. Give the group to the user or token the storage uses.

guestBackupsStorageUnread: Proxmox could not be asked which datastores this cluster backs up to, so this list goes by what it said when last asked, and is read-only until it answers: no restore or delete from here.
guestSnapshotsSharedDatastore: Matched by VMID on the datastores this cluster backs up to. A guest with the same VMID on another cluster that backs up to the same datastore shows here too: PBS cannot tell them apart.
startBackupDesc: Start a vzdump backup on the selected cluster.
restoreDesc: Restore {{type}}/{{id}} from {{datastore}} to a PVE node.
noPBSStorage: No PBS storage found on this PVE cluster. The PBS server must be added as a storage in PVE (Datacenter > Storage > Add > Proxmox Backup Server) before you can restore.
autoSelectedNode: Auto-selected {{node}} — VM {{vmid}} exists on this node.
defaultsToOriginal: Defaults to the original VMID. Change to restore as a new VM.
overwriteWarning: This will stop VM {{vmid}} and overwrite it with the backup. This cannot be undone.

serverDialog.verifyDescription: Verify the TLS certificate fingerprint before connecting.
serverDialog.trustedDescription: The server at <url>{{url}}</url> has a valid certificate signed by a trusted CA.
serverDialog.acceptFingerprint: I have verified this fingerprint and trust this certificate

pbsServerDialog.addDescription: Connect a Proxmox Backup Server by providing its API URL and an API token.
pbsServerDialog.tokenSecretReenter: Re-enter the token secret for the new address
pbsServerDialog.tokenSecretKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current secret
pbsServerDialog.addressMoved: This server is moving to a new address, so it needs the API token secret again — the stored one is only ever sent to the address it was saved for.
pbsServerDialog.associatedClusterHint: (roles on this cluster can see and manage it; with none, only install-wide roles can)
pbsServerDialog.selfSignedDescription: The server at <url>{{url}}</url> uses a self-signed certificate. Verify this fingerprint matches your PBS host before accepting.

deletePBSConfirm: This will permanently remove {{name}} and all associated backup data (snapshots, sync jobs, verify jobs, metrics). Type the server name to confirm.

deletePBSServerDialog.title: Delete PBS server
deletePBSServerDialog.description: This will permanently remove <name/> and all associated backup data (snapshots, sync jobs, verify jobs, metrics). Type the server name to confirm.

veeamServerDialog.addDescription: Connect a Veeam Backup & Replication server by its REST API address.
veeamServerDialog.editDescription: Changing the address or credentials re-tests the connection before saving.
veeamServerDialog.editVerifyDescription: The address changed. Verify the new host's certificate before saving.
veeamServerDialog.restApiPortHint: The REST API listens on port 9419, not the Veeam console port.
veeamServerDialog.usernameHint: A domain account must be fully qualified, backslash included. Veeam answers a mangled username with the same error as a wrong password.
veeamServerDialog.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password
veeamServerDialog.addressMoved: Saving will ask you to confirm the new host's TLS certificate, and needs the password again — the stored one is only ever sent to the address it was saved for.
veeamServerDialog.fetchCertificateFailed: Failed to fetch the TLS certificate
veeamServerDialog.addFailed: Failed to add the Veeam server
veeamServerDialog.updateFailed: Failed to update the Veeam server

veeamCertificate.selfSignedDescription: The server at <url>{{url}}</url> uses a self-signed certificate, the Veeam default. Verify this fingerprint matches your VBR host before accepting.

veeamRequirements.versionAndLicence: Requires Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1 or newer with an Enterprise Plus licence. Earlier builds do not report Proxmox job state usably, and Community Edition cannot back up Proxmox VE at all.
veeamRequirements.access: Nexara authenticates as a single administrator account. It reads job, session and restore-point state; it does not create or edit Veeam jobs.

deleteVeeamServerDialog.title: Delete Veeam server
deleteVeeamServerDialog.description: This removes <name/> from Nexara along with its stored credential. Backups and jobs on the Veeam server itself are not affected. Type the server name to confirm.
deleteVeeamServerDialog.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the Veeam server
